experiments.title: Julian TT/TDB/UTC epoch-label sensitivity
experiments.scientificQuestion: How do explicit TT, TDB, and UTC labels on the same synthetic Julian epoch change the represented instant and propagated direction?
mayEstablish: Measure scale sensitivity and warning/status differences.
cannotEstablish: Establish the I/311 time scale, approve TT, or set a tolerance.
experiments.requiredInputPolicy: Explicit ICRS, jyear scale, two-part TDB JD, mas per Julian year, parallax/RV; no EOP, observer, meteorology, or ephemeris.
experiments.reviewerApproval: AST-003 and AST-006 approval before measurements inform an epoch policy.
followUpDecisions: Bound candidate epoch-label consequences without deciding source meaning.

experiments.title: Calendar decimal-year comparison
experiments.scientificQuestion: How does calendar decimal year differ from a Julian epoch under otherwise identical synthetic motion?
mayEstablish: Measure instant, elapsed-time, and direction differences.
cannotEstablish: Make decimalyear an I/311 interpretation or define acceptance.
referenceDependencies: smoke-only pinned leap artifact when UTC conversion is exercised
experiments.requiredInputPolicy: Explicit representation and scale, ICRS, motion units, target instant, parallax/RV; no production data policy.
experiments.reviewerApproval: AST-003 and AST-006 approval before measurements inform an epoch policy.
followUpDecisions: Reject or bound the calendar-year alternative.

experiments.title: Besselian rejection guard

experiments.reviewerApproval: AST-003 approval before the guard becomes part of a production epoch adapter.
followUpDecisions: Freeze the rejection path for unsupported epoch representations.

experiments.title: Componentized-route equivalence

experiments.reviewerApproval: AST-003 and AST-006 approval before results inform route selection.
